request.purpose: Public health monitoring of chronic disease burden for the regional health authorities.
request.question: How many emergency visits did patients with asthma make in 2025, by region?
definitions: Asthma = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J45.
Count visits (not patients) of patients with asthma whose start_date is in 2025.
Report per region: emergency visits of patients with asthma.
